title: Infant formula, Enfamil AR, powder, made with water

content.title: About
content.content: Enfamil AR is a powdered infant formula designed for children with higher energy and nutrient needs. It provides proteins, fats, carbohydrates, vitamins, minerals, and added DHA and ARA to support brain and eye development. The powder is reconstituted with water to create a ready‑to‑feed product.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Enfamil AR is formulated for infants with rapid growth and weight gain.
Includes prebiotics to support a healthy gut microbiome.
Clinically tested for safety and efficacy.
Packaging is designed for convenient dosing during preparation.

items.title: Supports growth and development
items.content: A balanced mix of macro‑ and micronutrients meets the needs of a growing body.

items.title: Brain development
items.content: DHA and ARA aid in the formation of neural cells and visual system.

items.title: Gut health
items.content: Prebiotics promote beneficial bacteria, improving digestion.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Vitamins A, C, D and zinc help maintain the body’s defense mechanisms.

items.title: Energy provision
items.content: Higher fat and carbohydrate content supplies extra energy for active infants.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Children with known cow‑milk allergy may react to the formula.

items.title: Improper reconstitution
items.content: Too concentrated or too diluted mixtures can lead to dehydration or overfeeding.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Excessive intake may contribute to dental caries.

items.title: Storage after opening
items.content: Powder can absorb moisture, degrading quality and fostering microbial growth.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Mix the powder with clean, boiled water cooled to body temperature (≈37 °C). Follow the label’s instructions for the amount of powder per volume of water. Consume the prepared formula within 2 hours.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened container in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep the bag tightly sealed and use within 30 days.
